sample_unit: survey respondents (community members and physicians) rating LLM responses to brain aneurysm FAQs

links.outcome: Physician-rated consistency with current medical knowledge and guidelines, and omission of key points, in LLM answers
links.effect: ChatGPT and Gemini differed in consistency with current medical knowledge and practice guidelines (p = 0.001), omittance of key points (p < 0.001), and clinically relevant detail (p < 0.001); physicians rated LLM responses similar or somewhat worse than their own.
links.quote: Importantly, differences were found in consistency with current medical knowledge and practice guidelines (p = 0.001), omittance of key points (p < 0.001), and amount of clinically relevant detail included (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical survey comparing patient and physician perceptions/ratings of LLM responses (ChatGPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Flash) to questions about brain aneurysms; does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
